# t8.1 — T005 Traceability Correction and Revalidation

## Result

**Plan-to-task mapping: PASS.** Corrected the source t7 checkpoint so T005 appears under every inline plan reference (1.2, 1.3, and 1.4), then reran the mapping validation. All 13 tasks map to their inline plan references; all 10 plan items and 12 requirements remain covered. The T005 inconsistency recorded by t8 is resolved.

This is a documentation-only planning correction. No application code, API, payment behavior, database, Docker/Compose setup, router, or infrastructure was changed. The Phase 1 implementation/release gate remains pending; this PASS is not a Phase 1 release approval and does not authorize Phase 2.
